business_cases.expected_sql: SELECT (SUM(fct_sla_tickets.resolution_hours)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fct_sla_tickets.ticket_id), 0) AS mttr_hours FROM fct_sla_tickets LEFT JOIN dim_region ON fct_sla_tickets.region_id = dim_region.region_id WHERE dim_region.uf_code = 'AM' AND fct_sla_tickets.ticket_status = 'COMPLETED' LIMIT 100

business_cases.question: Receita líquida por UF para pedidos recebidos no Sul
business_cases.expected_sql: SELECT dim_region.uf_code AS uf_code, SUM(fct_revenue_orders.net_revenue_brl) AS total_revenue FROM fct_revenue_orders LEFT JOIN dim_region ON fct_revenue_orders.region_id = dim_region.region_id WHERE dim_region.macro_region = 'Sul' AND fct_revenue_orders.order_status = 'COLLECTED' GROUP BY dim_region.uf_code ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, uf_code ASC LIMIT 100
